answer: The sonnet assignment is published and sparrow records each panel. Shards are assigned from the gale graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 259 impostors cost 738 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
